forecasts.reasoning: Base rate: security incidents with confirmed model-weight exfiltration within 6 months ~ 0.1. Confirmations of specific weight exfiltration in security incidents are rare and slow; forensic attribution of the July HF swarm incident to actual OpenAI weight theft has not surfaced in 3+ months, and such confirmations typically take years if ever. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: years with new signed US-China bilateral trade agreements since 2018 ~ 0.1. US-China trade relations in 2026 are defined by the Section 301 overcapacity fight and strategic decoupling; a signed-and-jointly-announced NEW bilateral agreement within 10 weeks has no visible negotiating track. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.12.

Base rate: 10-week windows with simultaneous >threshold drawdowns in 4+ mega-caps ~ 0.05. Requires 4 of 7 Magnificent Seven stocks to crash per criteria before 2027; the S&P sits ~2.5% off its all-time high in late October and a synchronized mega-cap crash inside 10 weeks is a tail event. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.08.

Base rate: years since 2021 with NATO-attributed terror attacks staged from Afghanistan ~ 0.07. Both conditions (attack traced to Afghanistan-based group AND NATO attribution) within 10 weeks is a conjunction of rare events; no publicly attributed anti-NATO plot from Afghan soil has been confirmed in 2026 so far. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: years since 2023 with at least one federal AI EO or statute enacted ~ 0.6. An executive order counts, which lowers the bar substantially; the administration has been active with AI EOs, though its posture is deregulatory and a specifically safety-framed statute is unlikely in 10 weeks. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.3.

Base rate: calendar years of the Sudan civil war with an effective bilateral ceasefire ~ 0.1. Sudan's war grinds on with no credible bilateral ceasefire process; Burhan and Hemedti have no confirmed channel and external mediation (Jeddah, Geneva) has repeatedly failed to produce an effective in-force ceasefire. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: years since 2002 with 3+ day international arrival halts at a listed airport ~ 0.03. A 3+ consecutive day cessation of international arrival processing at a major US airport is unprecedented outside 9/11 and COVID; requires an extreme trigger (attack, system collapse, shutdown chaos) within 10 weeks. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: states newly enacting cage-free laws per 12-month window, 2016-2025 ~ 0.4. State legislative calendars mostly reconvene in January; a cage-free law enacted by a NEW state before July 2027 depends on 2027 sessions where several bills are pending; the 2015-2025 adoption pace is roughly one state per year. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.3.

Base rate: psychedelic therapies achieving FDA approval by their first projected date ~ 0.05. Clinical approval (FDA or equivalent acceptance as treatment) for psilocybin for end-of-life anxiety by Jan 1 2027 would require a completed Phase 3 and approval decision that is not on any public timeline; the MDMA rejection showed the bar. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.03.

Base rate: novel immigration enforcement program types established per year 2025-26 ~ 0.2. A formal federal or state bounty-style program rewarding deportation tips would be novel; immigration enforcement rhetoric is intense but no such program has been established through 10 months of 2026. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.25.

Base rate: communist single-party states losing power in any given year post-1991 ~ 0.02. The PCC retains full control of Cuba's institutions; economic crisis and emigration have not produced organized capability to displace the government, and 10 weeks is far too short absent a sudden collapse. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.03.

Base rate: years of Sudan war with a confirmed Burhan-Hemedti in-person meeting ~ 0.05. Burhan and Hemedti have refused direct contact through two years of war; a publicly confirmed in-person meeting during 2026 would require a mediation breakthrough of which there is no current sign with 10 weeks left. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.07.

Base rate: AI-created songs reaching Hot 100 top 20 since 2023 ~ 0.05. No AI-created song has charted top-20 on the Hot 100; viral AI tracks have been pulled or failed to sustain chart-eligible consumption, and the window is 10 weeks in a holiday-music-dominated chart period. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.12.

Base rate: rolling 10-week windows since 1950 containing a 5-day >10% S&P decline ~ 0.03. A >10% fall in 5 trading days has occurred only in 1987, 2008, 2020 and March 2025-type extremes; with the index near highs, the 10-week probability of a crash of that velocity is a few percent even in a war environment. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.05.

Base rate: obesity drugs approved within first expected regulatory cycle ~ 0.55. CagriSema completed Phase 3 REDEFINE readouts and Novo filed; an FDA decision window plausibly lands in late 2026 and EMA opinion could also qualify; approval by either regulator by Jan 1 2027 is close to an even-odds timing question. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.55.

Base rate: eVTOL commercial-launch promises met within the promised calendar year ~ 0.25. Joby and Archer have flown demonstration eVTOL flights in Dubai and commercial launch has been promised for 2026; a single paying commercial flight before Jan 1 2027 is plausible but certification and operations slip chronically. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.35.

Base rate: years since 2019 with waiver-authority-level legal changes ~ 0.3. Congressional CRA resolutions revoked specific California waivers in 2025 and litigation continues; a court ruling or enacted law eliminating the waiver AUTHORITY itself by Jan 1 2027 is a higher bar that remains unresolved. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.4.

Base rate: mega-event host economic projections judged met by rapid post-event data ~ 0.1. Resolving YES needs credible post-event data showing 6 of 11 US host cities hit projected boosts before Jan 1 2027; rigorous economic studies land months later and World Cup boosts habitually underdeliver versus projections. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: Waymo weekly-ride milestones hit within predicted quarters since 2023 ~ 0.15. Waymo ran ~250-300k weekly paid rides in early 2026 and scaling has continued across new metros, but 1M weekly by Dec 31 requires a 3-4x jump that outpaces every prior scaling curve segment. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.2.

Base rate: China advanced-node milestones achieved vs predicted dates since 2020 ~ 0.07. 150M+ transistors/mm2 requires roughly a 3nm-class process; SMIC remains at N+2/N+3 (5-7nm class) without EUV, and no credible evidence of production-grade 3nm density in China exists; the question window ends in 10 weeks. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.1.

Base rate: Israeli PMs leaving office within 10 weeks of an election loss ~ 0.2. Netanyahu faces a Knesset election on Oct 27 2026; even if his bloc loses, coalition formation means he typically remains PM into 2027, so ceasing to hold office BEFORE Jan 1 requires an unusually fast transition or internal replacement. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.22.

Base rate: annual departure rate of active US district judges ~ 0.03. A specific district judge leaving office within 10 weeks absent announced plans is rare; judicial departures average a few percent per seat-year and no retirement signal for Judge Ross is public. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.05.

Base rate: probability S&P avoids a >2.2% decline over 10 weeks, historical distribution ~ 0.66. S&P closed near 7,663 on Oct 24, about 2.2% above the 7,500 threshold; resolving needs the year-END close above 7,500, i.e. avoiding a >2% net decline over ~10 weeks; historical odds of that in a bull tape are roughly two-thirds. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.68.

Base rate: WHO PQ additions completed within anticipated year ~ 0.2. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.2.

Base rate: Speakers serving out a full Congress since 2015 ~ 0.65. Johnson has survived every 2025-26 procedural challenge and his conference has no appetite for another speaker fight before a midterm; the question requires continuity only until Jan 3 2027, with Congress mostly out post-election. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.7.

Base rate: months with first wild-animal detection after nearby livestock detections in prior outbreaks ~ 0.35. New World screwworm has spread north through Mexico with US detections in livestock in border states during 2026; a confirmed WILD animal detection in the contiguous US by USDA within 10 weeks is a live and rising possibility. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.45.

Base rate: municipal utility projects finishing by first announced completion date ~ 0.3. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.3.

Base rate: 301 investigations ending in new measures within statutory year ~ 0.6. Base rate: septic-to-sewer conversions finishing within announced year ~ 0.3. Base rate: years EUR appreciates vs USD, 1999-2025 ~ 0.48. Base rate: South Sudan election dates held as scheduled since 2015 ~ 0.1. Net of adjustments the final probability is 0.12.

Base rate: septic-to-sewer conversions finishing within announced year ~ 0.3.
